name: WireGuard Easy
tagline: WireGuard VPN with a web UI
description: The easiest way to run your own WireGuard VPN: web UI to add clients, show QR codes, and see live stats. Point your phone or laptop at it and you're on your home network from anywhere.
compose:
services:
  wg-easy:
    image: ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy:15
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:51821/tcp"
      - "${{cfg.vpn_port}}:51820/udp"
    environment:
      WG_HOST: "${{cfg.host}}"
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
      - SYS_MODULE
    sysctls:
      - net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
      - net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1
    volumes:
      - ./etc_wireguard:/etc/wireguard
      - /lib/modules:/lib/modules:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
